profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Backend Developer
profile.summary:
Known as an ambitious, results-driven software engineer and full stack developer that thrives when challenged and under pressure.  A big picture thinker who excels at marrying innovative ideas with best practices to create customer-centric products.  Contributes a proven record developing, deploying and maintaining full stack applications and APIs.

Career Highlights:
● Increased contract consumption for the company's largest customer account from 40% to 70%
● Created custom integration code packages for customers, which resulted in a lift to contract renewals
● Built a standardized deployment automation software that automated web and pdf publishing of mechanical engineering documents to reduce document publishing time for customers by over 75%
● Recognized for developing high quality custom web templates that increased customer contract renewal
● Developed/maintained a TypeScript codebase that increased the number of new customer contracts and reduced typical development time

Professional Skill Set:
● Full Stack Development
● Software Engineering
● SDLC Management
● Technology Innovation
● Quality Assurance
● Frontend | Backend Development
● User Experience | Management
● Training | Coaching | Mentorship
● Application Integration | Automation
● Customer Experience | Support
● Formal Presentations
● Resource Allocation
● CI | CD
● Product Installation
● Consulting | Advising

Technical Proficiencies:
● Programming Languages: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Python, PHP, C++, MySQL
● Web Development: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, GatsbyJS, Next.js, JQuery, Bootstrap4, GraphQL, Tailwind
● Backend Development: PassportJS, Linux, RHEL 7, MERN stack, Git/Github, PowerShell, Bash
● Server and Infrastructure: NGINX, Docker, Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Windows, Netlify

positions.title: Software Engineer - Integrations
positions.description:
Key Accountabilities:
● Responsible for creating integration code packages with JavaScript, Node.js and Passport.js; enabled seamless communication between web app and enterprise cloud applications for user authentication and access control
● Relied upon to implement/customize content templates for customers through an internal API using JavaScript
● Skillfully implemented LDAP and AD integrations for user authentication in the web application
● Spearheaded/managed RHEL VM deployments for customers to host the web application on-prem

Key Accomplishments:
● Increased contract consumption for the company's largest customer account from 40% to 70%
● Created custom integration code packages for customers, which resulted in a lift to contract renewals
● Built a standardized deployment automation software that automated web and pdf publishing of mechanical engineering documents to reduce document publishing time for customers by over 75%

positions.title: Software Engineer - Solutions
positions.description:
Key Accountabilities:
● Responsible for developing custom manufacturing templates for customers using HTML, CSS and JavaScript that were published to the web application
● Relied upon to develop/maintain a TypeScript codebase as an API to streamline the product development process for custom templates used by hundreds of customers

Key Accomplishments:
● Recognized for developing high quality custom web templates that increased customer contract renewal
● Developed/maintained a TypeScript codebase that increased the number of new customer contracts and decreased development time
